faq.q: What is the origin of Emine?
faq.a: Emine is associated with Arabic. Emine is the Turkish form of Arabic أَمِينَة (Amīna), meaning 'trustworthy'.
Yes — the underlying form أَمِينَة is Arabic.
Emine can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Emine should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Amīna is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Emine mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Emine is rendered آمینه and carries the sense آمینه، امین.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Emine, emine. Script forms are آمینه, أَمِينَة, امينه, امینہ, अमीना.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
